title: Profile
subtitle: Your account, language and time zone.
languageHelp: The language of the whole interface.
timezoneHelp: Every time is shown in this zone. Data is stored in UTC.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
passwordRules: At least 15 characters (12 with two-step verification), no spaces at the start or the end; do not use your e-mail, your name or “predigol”.

securityPanel.mfaHelp: Besides the password, signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.

identity.title: Confirm it is you
identity.body: To end other sessions, type your password or a code from your authenticator app.
identity.useCode: Use a code from the app

confirmEndOthers.title: Close the other sessions?
confirmEndOthers.body_one: {count} session open on another device will be closed; it will have to sign in again. This one stays open.
confirmEndOthers.body_other: {count} sessions open on other devices will be closed; they will have to sign in again. This one stays open.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Which e-mails we send you. Those about your account, its security, your requests about your data and changes to the legal texts always arrive.

categoryHelp.account: Invitation, activation and changes to your account.
categoryHelp.security: Recovering your password and sign-in notices.
categoryHelp.membership: Reminders before it expires and payment confirmations.
categoryHelp.support: Answers to your questions and reports.
categoryHelp.privacy: The receipt and the answer of your requests about your data.
categoryHelp.legal: Changes to the terms or the privacy policy you must accept.
categoryHelp.service: Scheduled maintenance, resolved incidents and important changes to PrediGol. An important change reaches you even if you switch this off.

status.bounced: Your e-mail bounces: we cannot deliver messages to you. Check that your account's address is right and write to us if it changed.
status.complained: You marked one of our e-mails as spam: we only send you what is essential about your account, its security, your data and the legal texts.

digest.title: Weekly summary
digest.help: It arrives once a week, from 9:00 in your time zone. You can leave it here or in one click from any summary.

sessionIdle: It closes sooner if you go {idle} without using it; every use renews it.

membership.title: Membership

line.grace: Your membership has ended: until {date} you keep full access.
line.expired: Your membership has ended. Your data stays here; renewing brings everything back.
line.suspended: Your account is suspended: write to us.
line.none: Your account has no membership period yet.

membership.willNotRenew: You told us you will not renew. If you change your mind, write to us.
membership.notEnforced: For now, access stays full even when the membership ends.
membership.renewHelp: You pay by the agreed means and we record it at once: the membership carries on from its end date, or from today if it has ended.
membership.renewNone: To renew, answer any of our e-mails or ask whoever invited you.
membership.whatsappText: Hello, I would like to renew my PrediGol membership.

banner.grace: Your membership has ended: until {date} you keep full access.
banner.expired: Limited access: your membership has ended. Renewing brings everything back.
banner.suspended: Your account is suspended: write to us.
banner.none: Your account is created, but it does not have access to PrediGol yet.

limited.expiredBody: Your data stays here. You can see your profile, your saved picks, the help and the legal texts, and download your data. Renewing brings everything back.
limited.suspendedBody: You can see your profile, your saved picks, the help and the legal texts, and download your data. Write to us to know more.
limited.noneBody: It does not have access to PrediGol yet. Meanwhile you can see your profile, the help and the legal texts, and download your data.
limited.readOnly: Read only while your access is limited.

plan.title: The plan
plan.priceHelp: You choose which currency you pay in.
plan.trial: You start with {days} days of trial with full access and no card.

includes.analysis: The analysis of every match and its reading
includes.explain: Explain: answers from what PrediGol already knows, nothing made up
includes.picks: Picks and parlays, when PrediGol publishes them: one is never made up to fill the space

plan.how: You pay by the means we agree with you and PrediGol records it by hand. There is no automatic charge: nothing is charged unless you agree to it.
plan.notBets: The membership pays for access to the analysis. PrediGol is not a bookmaker and takes no money for bets.

discount.title: Discounts and coupons
discount.offer: Your next payment has {percent}% off, from {source}.
discount.how: The discount applies when you renew: it is recorded with your payment. Nothing is charged automatically.
discount.none: Your next payment has no discount for now.
discount.loyalty: Loyalty discount: {percent}% off every renewal once you have completed {months} months of paid membership.
discount.loyaltyProgress_one: You have paid {count} month so far.
discount.loyaltyProgress_other: You have paid {count} months so far.
discount.rule: A coupon is good for a single payment and does not add up to the loyalty discount: the larger one applies.
discount.tooMany: You tried too many codes that are not valid. Wait a few minutes and try again.

pay.closedTitle: Paying by Nequi or Bre-B is not enabled yet
pay.closedBody: We are finishing the payment set-up. Write to us on WhatsApp and we will help you activate your access.
pay.qrAlt: Nequi QR code to pay your PrediGol membership
pay.afterPaying: Once you pay, tell us below with “I paid”. We check that the money arrived and open your access.
pay.referenceHelp: We keep only the last 4 characters. Never type a card number.
pay.fieldPayer: Name of the person who paid (optional)
pay.acceptTerms: I accept the membership's purchase conditions.

problem.amount: Type an amount greater than zero, for example 150000.
problem.paidOn: Pick a day within the last {days} days, not in the future.
problem.terms: To send the notice you have to accept the purchase conditions.

pay.noCharge: PrediGol does not charge you or keep your card details: you pay outside and we verify.
pay.waitingBody: We received your notice. We check that the money arrived before the end of {date} (one business day). As soon as we confirm it, we open your access and write to you.
pay.waitingNoRepay: You do not have to pay again or send another notice. If you got a detail wrong, cancel this notice and send another.
pay.rejected: We could not confirm your last payment: {reason}. Check the details and send a new notice, or write to us.
pay.annulled: We corrected the record of your last payment and that period was annulled. Write to us and we will sort it out.

reason.amount_mismatch: the amount received does not match the membership's price
reason.not_received: we do not see the money in our account yet
reason.unreadable: we could not validate the details you sent
reason.other: there is a detail we could not validate

pay.whatsappText: Hello, I have a question about paying for my PrediGol membership.

centre.subtitle: Your account, your football, your notifications, your privacy and your security, in one place.
centre.summaryError: We could not read your account's summary. The blocks still work.

alias.label: Alias
alias.help: How PrediGol greets you. Only you see it (and PrediGol, if you write to us).

help.title: Help
help.label: Help and contact
help.centerHint: Answers to the most common questions
help.reportHint: Tell us what happened: we answer here and by e-mail

summary.footballNone: You follow no league or team yet
summary.emailBounced: Your e-mail bounced: nothing reaches you now
summary.emailComplained: You marked an e-mail as spam: we send you no more
summary.requestsUntil_other: {n} open requests; the first is due on {date}
summary.privacyOk: Authorisations up to date · no open request
